title: The speeds of propagation for the monostable Lotka-Volterra competition-diffusion system in general unbounded domains
summary: This paper is concerned with the speeds of propagation for the monostable Lotka-Volterra competition-diffusion system in general unbounded domains of $\mathbb{R}^N$. We first establish various definitions of spreading speeds at large time in the situation where one species is an invader and the other is a resident. Then, we study fundamental properties of these new definitions, including their relationships and their dependence on the geometry of the domain and the initial values.
